title: Graph Linear Equations Review Test
description: Graph lines by plotting the y-intercept and using slope as rise over run.

questions.questionText: To graph y = -1/2x - 2, start at the y-intercept and move right 2 units. Which point do you reach?
questions.explanation: Start at the y-intercept (x = 0). Multiply the slope by the horizontal change of 2, then add that vertical change to the starting y-value. This gives (2, -3). Other points may lie on the line but do not match the requested movement.

questions.questionText: Which graphing description matches y = 2/5x?
options: Start at 0 on the y-axis, then use slope -2/5
Start at 1 on the y-axis, then use slope 2/5
Start at 2/5 on the y-axis, then use slope 0
Start at 0 on the y-axis, then use slope 2/5
questions.correctAnswer: Start at 0 on the y-axis, then use slope 2/5
questions.explanation: Graph a line by plotting the y-intercept first, then using slope as rise over run to find another point.
